title: Yeshivos Move Up Summer Schedules
body: A growing number of yeshivos in the tri-state area are ending the spring/summer period earlier, starting the new school year in mid-August, weeks ahead of the traditional start.

title: Gedolim Back Draft Law
body: Rav Chaim Kanievsky and other gedolim of Degel HaTorah and Shas held secret meetings, ultimately instructing their MKs to advance the draft-law proposal in the Knesset.

title: Rav's Letters Reveal Draft Truth
body: Rav Elazar Menachem Man Shach and Rav Aharon Leib Shteinman's letters reveal draft deferments for yeshivah students were always conditional: only someone fully dedicated to Torah study qualifies.
